description: Occupant load, seat capacity and minimum patron and employee water closets and lavatories for an Ontario restaurant or bar (Building Code Table 3.7.4.3.-D, -E and -F). Preliminary planning figure only. The architect, the public health unit, the building official and the permit set govern the seat count and the fixture count.

dining_area_m2.description: Dining, beverage and cafeteria floor area open to patrons (required). Unit: m2.

employees.description: Employees normally present at one time, those present more than 25 percent of the working day (Sentence 3.7.4.3.(9)). Unit: people.

male_pct.description: Share counted as male, 0 to 100. The rest are counted as female. Unit: percent.

seats.description: Seats planned. 0 to use the occupant load from the area. The occupant load is the larger of the two. Unit: seats.

service.description: restaurant: a dining room or cafeteria (Table 3.7.4.3.-D). bar: an establishment used primarily for alcoholic beverages with limited or no food service (Table 3.7.4.3.-E).

storeys.description: Storeys in the building (sets the minimum number of universal washrooms). Unit: storeys.

urinals.description: Use urinals for males up to the Code limit.

name: restaurant_seating_and_washroom_requirement
